excluded_rule_ids.description: List of ModSecurity rule IDs to disable entirely across all requests.

excluded_rule_targets.description: List of per-parameter rule exclusions (e.g., for known false positives in specific query/body parameters).

items.description: Exclusion targeting a specific rule and parameter

target_type.description: Type of request component to exclude (e.g., 'arg' for query string parameters)

param_name.description: Name of the parameter to exclude (e.g., 'search', 'id', 'q')

debug_mode.description: Enable debug-level logging for exclusion rules (not recommended in production).
